title: Craftable Red Sand Blocks
description: Allows you to craft red sand (and associated blocks) by using 8 sand and an iron ingot.
body:
Craft red sand blocks with sand blocks and iron nuggets. All recipes are shapeless, and are made of 8 of the sand block and 1 iron nugget.

![Red sand recipe made of 8 sand and 1 iron nugget](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3961918a3e02d3555fadfd5d5e1b2692b77c678.png)
![Red sandstone slab recipe made of 8 sandstone slabs and 1 iron nugget](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed5c9d11b3fd5128ad64705e4ab50de6f6418d9a.png)

This datapack is only verified to work in 1.21.11, but it will probably work in previous versions if the minimum version in the pack.mcmeta file is changed.

Credit to the Minecraft Wiki for the red sand image.
